disposition: Excluded DEV construction preflight; no producer or held-out feedback.

review.summary: The supplied frames support two complete local blinks, with coherent curved eyelids and preserved portrait identity.

checks.criterion: Preserve the source portrait, texture and print.
checks.evidence: The initial frame matches the reference; face shape, nose, fur marks, paper and lettering remain visibly unchanged.

checks.criterion: Move only the eye openings and eyelid edges.
checks.evidence: Sampled transitions show localized eyelid movement while the face, forehead, eye surrounds and composition remain stationary.

checks.criterion: Complete two smooth blinks and restore the original open eyes.
checks.evidence: Progressive closure and reopening surround fully closed frames 9 and 26. Original open eyes return between blinks and in the ending frames.

checks.criterion: Use coherent curved lids that occlude unchanged irises and pupils.
checks.evidence: Detail crops show curved openings progressively masking stationary pupils. Beige lids match the source eye surrounds, without visible ghosting, rectangular wipes, detached arcs or conspicuous patch seams.

limitations: Assessment uses supplied timestamped frames and detail crops; continuous playback and unsupplied frames were not reviewed.

review.summary: The sampled sequence supports a clean crossing behind both plant clusters and in front of the mural, with the original subject and stationary composition preserved.

checks.criterion: Preserve the supplied subject’s pattern, colors, proportions and silhouette.
checks.evidence: Visible portions retain the reference’s orange polygon, cream concentric rings, dark diagonal line and outline.

checks.criterion: Keep both foreground plant clusters ahead of the subject and the mural behind it.
checks.evidence: Leaves and stems occlude the subject during both crossings; mural lines disappear beneath the subject.
Plant clusters, mural, paper, lettering and border remain aligned across the supplied frames and match the scene reference.
Detail crops show coherent subject and leaf edges without obvious halos, rectangular cutouts or carried landscape fragments.

checks.criterion: Travel continuously rather than freeze between sampled views.
checks.evidence: Consecutive sampled frames show advancing positions at the beginning, middle and ending, with continued progress through both crossings.

limitations: Review is based on supplied frames and detail crops, not playback of every frame.

review.summary: The restored print visibly matches the donor and preserves the surrounding original, with no apparent repair artifacts.

checks.evidence: The repaired central stem and curved branches align cleanly with surrounding lines, without visible ghosting or doubled edges.

checks.criterion: Paper texture, lettering, diacritics and rules
checks.evidence: The repaired paper blends with its surroundings; the heading, small lettering, accents and horizontal rule appear coherent with the donor.
The surrounding plants, registration marks, title, footer and border remain visually consistent with the damaged original.

checks.criterion: Removal of stain and guide without visible artifacts
checks.evidence: No purple stain, cyan markings, obvious seam or blurred patch is visible in the finished print.

limitations: Assessment is based on the supplied full-image views; pixel-exact preservation and very fine texture differences cannot be established.

authored_control_validation.visual_qa: All 36 frames of both triangle/cosine examples for four blink tasks, all 36 frames for four occlusion tasks, and four restored print masters inspected by task and independent quality agents.
authored_control_validation.negative_controls: Frozen eyes, instant closure, iris crossfade, moved pupils, whole-face motion, wrong foreground order, opaque sprite padding, misregistered donor, blurred fine text, unauthorized source edits, non-RGB format and unavailable decode are rejected or unverified.
